title: Curve 真实老人纵向外部站点验证预注册

population.note: 工程试点规模；不作为临床有效性证明。最终样本量须由统计负责人结合预期效应、失访和事件率确认。

primary_analysis.primary_model: Curve locked horizon-specific nested rolling-origin selection pipeline
primary_analysis.superiority_rule: Curve is advantageous only if participant-bootstrap 95% CI upper bounds for MAE deltas versus both comparators are below 0 and participant-macro MAE is lower than both comparators; otherwise the conclusion is 未证明优势。

intervals.note: 区间宽度不设事后优化阈值；任何临床可接受宽度须由临床与统计负责人在解盲前另行签署。

refusal_rules: fewer than 28 valid historical days for external 7-day scoring eligibility
no stable model or model does not beat an eligible simple baseline in origin-only backtesting
horizon model bucket is not ready
maximum interval margin exceeds max(20% of historical median, 1 native unit)

participant_level: participant_id is not unique to exactly one site
age at enrollment is below 60 or unavailable
fewer than 28 valid days for the primary 7-day analysis
record_level: unsupported metric, unit, condition, or posture
quality_flag is excluded or missing for scoring
exclusion_rules.policy: Apply rules without consulting external-site outcomes; report counts and reasons. Do not impute measurement values.

sample_size_basis.pilot_floor: 100 participants followed for about 90 days across at least two sites tests recruitment, retention, data transfer, missingness, device heterogeneity and pipeline execution.
sample_size_basis.external_site_floor: At least 50 participants in the fully held-out site is an engineering gate, not a powered clinical claim.
sample_size_basis.confirmatory_calculation: Before recruitment is finalized, a statistician must use blinded internal/pilot variance estimates, the minimally important MAE difference, two-sided alpha, desired power, cluster/within-participant dependence, expected refusal, missingness, attrition and subgroup multiplicity.

freeze.changes_after_freeze: Versioned protocol amendment with reason, timestamp and signatures; original manifest remains immutable.
